summary: A Google DeepMind product lead reports that Gemini has surpassed 100 million active iOS users and that macOS power users prompt roughly twice as often as users on other surfaces.

mechanisms.reason: The post states concrete user-adoption and usage-frequency figures indicating growing aggregate inference volume for Gemini on Apple platforms.
mechanisms.quote:
Over 100M+ active users on iOS
+ macOS power users prompt ~2x more frequently than other surfaces
